items.headline: RBC Canadian Open lead logjam
items.text: Sahith Theegala heads a six-man tie at -6 after a 64 at TPC Toronto, joined by Emiliano Grillo, Eric Cole, Brooks Koepka, Sam Burns, and Matthew Anderson as Round 2 promises a tight competition.

items.headline: Furyk critiques Ryder Cup switch
items.text: Jim Furyk stated the hole switch by Scottie Scheffler and Russell Henley at the last Ryder Cup 'should not have happened,' reflecting broader Team USA issues.
